mobile_performance.notes: Runtime cold-start optimization. /chats Android P95 8276.43 N436, iOS 6145.82 N81 (low); /characters Android 7961.23 N293 and iOS 7096.16 N77 (low). Targets each 4000ms content-ready. API platform baselines in api block are independent successful groups samples, 2000ms target. Root shell-only alias has no separate real cohort, no invented baseline; use actual destination/platform and document time zero. See design/research.
mobile_performance.post_release_verification: At least 24 hours before/after a controlled release, same cohort/platform/source, extend 48-72h for low traffic and require at least 100 successful samples. Verify errors, cancellation, missing reports, billing and rollback conditions; no mandatory fixed-sample local performance runner.

scope: Root document entry, HTML/SDK ready and canonical URL
Visible conversation first-page queue and API classification
integration_points: Reuse early-startup/startup-timing/page-tracker Sentry and Faro exporters without extra endpoint
Reuse apiClient request timing and finite grafana api_route allowlist
Backend unchanged: existing operation.terminal http.request Pino and X-Request-Id/X-Trace-Id continue for original routes
failure_paths: Blocked JS/bridge remains shell-only, SDK fallback and native ready dedup remain
Unknown cookie or layout segment never selects arbitrary path; history failure must not expose launch data or leave broken business routing
Queue timeout, caller abort, API failure and bounded safe GET retry remain current owner
Telemetry unavailable cannot gate initialization, navigation or requests; no suppression of hydration failures
logging_integration.correlation: Reuse release/platform/finite route and existing request timing; backend response headers retain request/trace identifiers. No extra DB lookups or user identifiers as labels.
logging_integration.redaction: Finite routes/stages only; never raw URL, query/hash, cookie, initData, token, user data, response content or payment URL. Backend safe {err} projection unchanged.
logging_integration.alerting: Reuse current default-off alerts, no new notifications; failure isolation and expected caller cancellation severity unchanged. Compare groups independently after release because historical detail included groups.
verification: Existing startup/page-tracker, api-timing/grafana/queue tests and expanded local @startup flows; assert original document clock and no duplicate request
Frontend typecheck/tests/lint/build, existing API fixture checks and no secret output
Post-release same-release platform/route P95 plus started/terminal/stall samples; review Railway correlation only when released
